title: Delivery Claims Decision Criteria (Claims Review Board Matrix)
content:
**Standard.** A Delivery Claims claim is decided within the claim type's decision time in business days of reaching under review. Missing evidence, a window missed or an excluded cause leads to denial with the matching reason; every other complete claim of the right type is approved with its resolution.

## Type-specific criteria

**Late Delivery Claim.** Approved only for a delivery service whose delivery date is guaranteed under the Online Orders service terms, when the days late — the calendar days from the order's promised delivery date to its delivered date — are at least the claim type's late threshold. It is denied with the reason not late otherwise, and with the reason guarantee suspended when the promised delivery date falls from the claim type's suspension start through its suspension end.

**Delivered Not Received Claim.** Denied with the reason signature on file when the carrier captured a signature at delivery, unless a police report is logged on the claim.

**Any claim type.** A claim whose compensation would exceed the claim type's compensation cap is not decided by the agent; it is handed to a human representative.

## Matrix

| Finding on a complete claim | Outcome |
|---|---|
| required evidence missing | denied, evidence missing |
| claim opened outside the reporting window | denied, outside reporting window |
| excluded cause | denied, excluded cause |
| Late Delivery Claim on a service without a guaranteed delivery date, or days late below the late threshold | denied, not late |
| Late Delivery Claim with the promised delivery date inside the suspension period | denied, guarantee suspended |
| Delivered Not Received Claim with a carrier-captured signature and no police report logged | denied, signature on file |
| Delivered Not Received Claim with a carrier-captured signature and a police report logged | not denied on this ground |
| compensation would exceed the compensation cap | not decided by the agent; handed to a human representative |
| none of the above, claim of the right type | approved with its resolution |

## Worked cases (hypothetical, Late Delivery Claim with a late threshold of 1 day)

- Promised 8 May, delivered 8 May: 0 days late, below the threshold — denied, not late.
- Promised 8 May, delivered 9 May, service with a guaranteed date: 1 day late — the lateness criterion is met.
- Promised 8 May, delivered 11 May, service whose delivery date is not guaranteed: denied, not late.
